errors.description: The sleeve head is not in the picture. Both shoulder end points run off the left and right frame edges of a head-and-chest portrait.
errors.expected: Frame WIDE so both ends of the shoulder sit inside the picture with clear background beyond each.
errors.actual: Frontal portrait cropped at both shoulders; no background margin beyond either shoulder end; zero sleeve-head area visible.

errors.description: Nothing in the frame distinguishes a STRUCTURED sleeve head from the Natural option. Placed beside sport-coat/sleeve-natural candidate-7 the two images are near-identical in crop, navy hopsack cloth, lighting and model; a customer comparing them could not tell structured from unpadded.

errors.actual: A generic soft navy jacket portrait indistinguishable from its sibling option.

errors.description: Padding level and armhole-seam transition — two of the three mandatory geometry-coverage items — are outside the crop and cannot be verified at any magnification.
errors.expected: Visible structured sleeve head and armhole-seam transition.
errors.actual: Cropped away at both frame edges.

notes: Graded candidate-7 (attempt 7 of 7 already on disk; no credits spent this session). Drawing SHSMD/B was magnified 7x and does differ from SHSMD/A — flatter shoulder line, crisper shoulder-end corner — so the option IS distinguishable in principle; the render simply crops the distinguishing region out.
